scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur suraksha upakaran sahaayata yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh.
Applicant must be a registered construction worker in Chhattisgarh.
Application can be made only after 90 days of registration.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement up to Rs. 1,500 for safety equipment (helmets, footwear, gloves, safety jackets, masks) purchased by the worker.
